preregistration.one_attempt_consumed_when: ollama create process starts after all venue/asset/Q4/namespace preconditions PASS

failure_localization.expression: ollama.exe create <owned-model> -f <frozen-Modelfile> with stderr merged into PowerShell pipeline
failure_localization.implementation_mechanism: Windows PowerShell 5.1 native stderr emitted by ollama create was promoted into the PowerShell error stream under ErrorActionPreference=Stop before CreateRc and create evidence were recorded.

classifier_discrepancy.reason: The preregistered adjudication is phase-specific: create failure maps to FAIL_PACKAGE. The script fallback emitted FAIL_RUNTIME only because the PowerShell exception escaped before the explicit create return-code branch.

authoritative_verdict.interpretation: The exact Q4 and pinned Ollama runtime passed all pre-create identity and namespace gates, but the single authorized attempt failed during owned Ollama package creation. No claim about chat parity, runtime accuracy, or reasoning behavior is supported by this run.

engineering_followup.scope: Post-closure harness hardening for future programs only; must not be used to rerun or reinterpret this consumed M6 attempt.
engineering_followup.candidate_fix: Isolate ollama create native stdout/stderr from Windows PowerShell error semantics using Start-Process or equivalent explicit process I/O capture and exit-code adjudication.
